steps.name: Respond call
steps.canonicalLine: FMV 123 to Ops Ctr, responding to {location} for case of {callText}.

mustHit.label: Call sign: "FMV XXX to Ops Ctr"
"Responding to" the location
"Case of" the call text

steps.name: Call caller
steps.canonicalLine: Hi, I am calling from 995 FMV. My name is EMT XXX. We are on our way to your place now. Can I confirm your address / location? May I know what happened to the patient? How many casualties are there? Is the patient conscious or unconscious? {callExtras} Please prepare patient's ID and medication for us when we arrive.

mustHit.label: Intro: calling from 995 FMV, my name is EMT XXX
Confirm the exact address / location
May I know what happened to the patient?
How many casualties are there?
Is the patient conscious or unconscious?
Please prepare the patient's IC and medication
Is the patient breathing?
Not breathing: inform Ops Ctr to start tele-CPR
Any critical injuries present?
What vehicles are involved in the accident?

guidance: If unconscious, ask if breathing; if not, tele-CPR.
Trauma: ask about critical injuries and vehicles.

steps.name: Preparation
steps.canonicalLine: Crew, please don latex gloves & face mask. {say:extra-ppe} Bring the B.B.O.L.T.Z.: burn kit, blanket & canvas, O2 bag, LSU, trauma bag and Zoll.

mustHit.label: Crew don latex gloves & face mask
Extra PPE if the scene needs it: RTA vests, helmets, raincoats, PPE gowns
mustHit.say: Wear RTA vests, helmets, raincoats & PPE gowns for precautions.

mustHit.label: Equipment to bring: B.B.O.L.T.Z.

replies.text: Crew ready. You've arrived on scene.

guidance: "4 in 1" plus LSU accepted as the equipment list.

steps.name: Rescue scene evaluation
steps.canonicalLine: Are there any witnesses? What is the environment like? Are there any hazards / potential hazards / danger to the patient and ourselves? MOI is suspected case of {callText}.

mustHit.label: Are there any witnesses?
What is the environment like?
Any hazards / potential hazards / danger to the patient and ourselves?
MOI: "Suspected case of XXX"

guidance: Done before approaching.
MOI must use "suspected".

steps.name: Approach patient
steps.canonicalLine: Approaching casualty from the front. If you can hear me, please do not move your head. Is there any catastrophic bleeding? {say:bleeding-control} Any hazards around the patient? Remove any hazards. Never move the patient's head.

mustHit.label: Sound out: approaching from the front, please do not move your head
Is there any catastrophic bleeding?
Arrest the bleeding: Expose & Examine, direct pressure, pressure dressing, then C.A.T.
mustHit.say: Buddy, expose and examine. Arrest the bleeding first: direct pressure followed by secondary pressure dressing, and apply C.A.T. if still bleeding.

mustHit.label: Any hazards around the patient? Remove them
Never move the patient's head

guidance: Timer starts here.
Order: sound out, bleeding, hazards, never move head.
Head grip belongs to Introduction, not Approach.

steps.name: Introduction
steps.canonicalLine: Hi Sir/Ma'am, I am EMT XXX from SCDF. My buddy will do a head grip on you, please allow him. May I know what is bothering / happening to you Sir/Ma'am?

mustHit.label: Intro: I am EMT XXX from SCDF
My buddy will do a head grip on you, please allow him
May I know what is bothering / happening to you?

guidance: Head grip starts here, not in step 5.

steps.name: LOC (AVPU)
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, can you hear me? Patient is alert and responsive, LOC is A on the AVPU scale.

mustHit.label: Get a response from the patient
State the level aloud: Alert, Verbal, Pain or Unresponsive

guidance: No response at A: go V, then P.
U: fast-check A, B, C.

branches.note: Fast-check A, B, C, then CPR or rescue breathing, and OPA. Later phase.

steps.name: Delicate spine
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, did you fall? Did you hit your head? Sir/Ma'am, please allow me to check if you have sustained any potential spinal injuries. Do you feel any pain at your neck? Palpating the back of the neck for deformities, tenderness, bruises and lacerations. {say:c-collar} {say:release-grip}

mustHit.label: Did you fall? Did you hit your head?
Ask permission: please allow me to check for spinal injuries
Do you feel any pain at your neck?
Palpate the back of the neck for D.T.B.L.
"No suspected spinal injuries, buddy remove head grip"
mustHit.say: No suspected spinal injuries, buddy remove head grip.

mustHit.label: Apply C-collar (ENSAPA): establish neutral position, measure, apply
mustHit.say: Establish neutral position, measure & apply C-collar.

guidance: No pain: "No suspected spinal injuries, buddy remove head grip."
Pain: keep grip, C-collar (ENSAPA).

steps.name: Airway
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, are you still with me? Patient is conscious and airway is clear. Checking the mouth for any obstacles. {say:head-tilt-chin-lift} {say:jaw-thrust} Smelling for unusual breath smells: GTN, alcohol or fruity smell.

mustHit.label: Ask for a response: are you still with me?
State: patient is conscious and airway is clear
Head tilt, chin lift to check the mouth for obstacles
Spinal injury: modified jaw thrust
Smell for unusual breath smells

guidance: Spinal: modified jaw thrust.
Unconscious: OPA steps.

steps.name: Breathing
steps.canonicalLine: Is there chest rise & fall? What is the rate & quality of the breathing? Arm buddy, please measure the SpO2 reading on room air. Sir/Ma'am, do you have any lung problems, like any hx of asthma e.g. bronchial asthma or COPD e.g. chronic bronchitis, emphysema? {say:monitor-closely} Is there any cyanosis of lips, nasal flaring, tracheal tugging, pursed lips & use of accessory muscles? Putting on the appropriate mask and flow rate based on Guidelines.

mustHit.label: Look for chest rise & fall
What is the rate & quality of the breathing?
Arm buddy: measure SpO2 on room air
Any lung problems, like hx of asthma or COPD?
"I will monitor the patient closely after giving oxygen"
mustHit.say: I will monitor the patient closely after giving oxygen.

mustHit.label: Check N.T.U.C.P.
Put on the appropriate mask and flow rate

guidance: If asthma / COPD: "I will monitor closely after giving oxygen."
Above 95%: nasal cannula optional.
COPD: nasal cannula.

steps.name: Circulation
steps.canonicalLine: Checking the radial pulse. Is there pulse? What is the rate & quality of the pulse?

mustHit.label: Check the pulse: radial (carotid if unconscious)
What is the rate & quality of the pulse?

steps.name: Rapid body survey
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, I'm going to conduct a Rapid Body Survey to check for any life or limb threatening injuries. Please allow me. If you feel any pain or discomfort, please sound out. Head, neck, chest, abdomen, pelvis, lower extremities, upper extremities and back, with eye contact. Checking my gloves for sweat or blood. Are there any abnormalities noted? {say:distal-pulse} {say:immobilise} Checking for JVD at 45° and pedal edema. Sir/Ma'am, may I check your pockets for any medications, IC and Medic Awas tag? {say:c-collar-after-rbs}

mustHit.label: Ask permission: Rapid Body Survey for life or limb threatening injuries
RBS in order: head, neck, chest, abdomen, pelvis, lower extremities, upper extremities, back
Maintain eye contact throughout
Are there any abnormalities noted / found?
JVD at the neck (sit at 45°)
Pedal edema: press and check for pitting
Check your hands / gloves for sweat or blood
Pocket check, after seeking permission
Check radial / distal pulses of injured limbs
mustHit.say: Checking distal pulses of injured limbs.

mustHit.label: Instruct buddy where to immobilise / stabilise
Apply C-collar after RBS (ENSAPA): establish neutral position, measure, apply
mustHit.say: Establish neutral position, measure & apply C-collar.

guidance: JVD and pedal edema may come after asking about pain.
Pocket check is often missed: always flag it.

steps.name: Investigation
steps.canonicalLine: Auscultating point 1 right apex, point 2 left apex, point 3 right side, point 4 left side, point 5 right base and point 6 left base. Is there air entry? Is air entry equal? Are there any abnormal breath sounds? Sir/Ma'am, I am going to take your blood pressure. May I know which arm I can take the BP from? Do you have any AV shunt / fistula, or any chest operations, specifically breast cancer removal? Taking the BP on the {bpArm} arm. ECG: 12-lead if lung / heart issues, otherwise 4-lead. Checking the hypocount. {say:suspected-hypo}

mustHit.label: Auscultate all 6 points, with the 3 questions
Before BP: any AV shunt / fistula or chest operations?
Name the arm for BP
ECG type with reason: 12-lead or 4-lead
Hypocount
Hypocount under 4: "suspected hypoglycaemia"

guidance: Screening questions count as choosing the arm, but the arm must still be named.
12-lead for chest pain, SOB, cardiac, syncope; else 4-lead.
Hypocount under 4: "suspected hypoglycaemia".

steps.name: Vital signs
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, I am going to take your vital signs now. Please allow me. GCS: eye opening, verbal (what is your name, where are you now?) and motor (please raise both arms), then the GCS score. On a scale of 1 to 10, with 1 being the least and 10 being the most, how would you rate your pain / discomfort? Head buddy, please check temperature, respiratory rate, and skin colour & condition. Arm buddy, please check SpO2, pulse rate, blood pressure and capillary refill time. Buddy, please reassess vital signs every 5 mins and inform me.

mustHit.label: Ask permission to take vital signs
GCS: eyes, verbal, motor, and the score
Severity: on a scale of 1 to 10, with 1 being the least and 10 being the most
Head buddy: temperature, respiratory rate, skin colour & condition
Arm buddy: SpO2, pulse rate, blood pressure, capillary refill time
"Buddy, please reassess vital signs every 5 mins and inform me"

guidance: One of person / place / time is enough for verbal.
Severity is of the chief complaint (e.g. giddiness), not always "pain".

steps.name: Oxygen
steps.canonicalLine: Arm buddy, please recheck the SpO2. Reassessing patient condition: maintain or titrate the oxygen mask and flow rate based on Guidelines.

mustHit.label: Recheck SpO2 and reassess the patient's condition
Maintain or titrate the oxygen mask and flow rate
Sir/Ma'am, how are you feeling?

steps.name: Position
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, which position is the most comfortable for you? If that position is not ideal: {positionAdvice}.

mustHit.label: Which position is the most comfortable for you?
If not ideal, convince them: sitting up eases breathing; lying flat (supine) helps low BP

guidance: Sitting up for SOB or chest pain.
Supine (lying flat) for low BP, e.g. heavy bleeding.

steps.name: Decision point
steps.canonicalLine: Patient is unstable due to {signs}, suspected {suspected}. {decisionLine} As I am an FMV EMT, I cannot send unstable case, I will call for ambulance to convey. Meanwhile, I will continue to give my treatment and monitoring of patient every 5 mins till ambulance arrives.

mustHit.label: "Patient is unstable due to (2 signs)"
"Suspected X"
Stay & Treat: "I will Stay & Treat to see whether I can initiate any protocols"
Load & Go: "It is a Load & Go case"
FMV EMT cannot send unstable case: call for ambulance to convey
Monitor the patient every 5 mins till the ambulance arrives

guidance: Reasons should be signs, not the diagnosis.

steps.name: Notification
steps.canonicalLine: Sir/Ma'am, may I have your IC please? Does the name match? Does the IC number match? Does the photo match? FMV 123 to Ops Centre, standby message, over. FMV 123, requesting for Alpha for unstable case of {sex} / {race} / {age} / case of {suspected} due to {signs} / IC no. {ic} / ETA {eta} mins.

mustHit.label: Retrieve the patient's IC after seeking permission
Confirm identity: name, IC number and photo match
negatives: may i have your ic number

mustHit.label: "FMV XXX to Ops Centre, standby message, over"
Request Alpha for unstable case: sex, race, age, case, 2 signs, IC no., ETA

replies.text: Name, IC number and photo match.

guidance: Age range (e.g. "70s") accepted.
ETA = time left of the 20 mins.
